title: Skill Graph Construction
description: Skills become nodes, prerequisites become edges; the graph is built from task decompositions. The map shows what learning what unlocks. Competence gets mapped.

demo.code:
print("nodes: 1,204 skills, edges: 3,400 prereqs")
print("map: complete")
_jah_schema = {'technique': 'Decomposition', 'nodes': 'Skills', 'edges': 'Prerequisites', 'use': 'Curriculum', 'benefit': 'Mapped', 'complexity': 'Medium'}
print("technique:", _jah_schema["technique"])
assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'nodes', 'edges', 'use', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")
